evidence: log loss +0.0147 (95% interval +0.0056 to +0.0230). The model's probabilities are WORSE than the market's closing probabilities (the interval is above zero).

338 picks, ROI +0.6% (95% interval -7.2% to +8.1%), win rate 59.8% against a break-even 59.0%. Random sides at the same margin match or beat this 17% of the time. Line movement toward the pick after it was made: +0.11 probability points on average (zero means no closing-line value).
How many bets before ROI can be trusted

At the observed spread of results, detecting a true 3% ROI takes about 4,880 bets and a 5% ROI about 1,757; a 1% edge takes 43,917. Closing-line value converges much faster, which is why it is the primary measure.
